title: AI attribution: does paqad's own footer follow the same switch?
context: paqad's PR body template (.paqad/templates/pr-body.md) ends with the line '(robot) Generated with paqad-ai delivery'. If an enterprise objects to a vendor name in the PR body, paqad's own footer is the same objection.

options.label: paqad footer follows the same switch (stripped together)
Always keep the paqad footer (it is the customer's own tool)
A separate knob for the paqad footer

rationale: Keep paqad, because that is what enterprise signed up for. paqad is the customer's own governance tool, not a third-party AI vendor; its delivery footer is a feature they bought, so the strip switch targets host-agent AI attribution only.
